title: Distinct Job Titles
description:
Report each distinct job title held by at least one employee.

Name the column `title`. Return the result in any order.
schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE departments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  salary INTEGER,
  dept_id INTEGER,
  manager_id INTEGER,
  hire_date TEXT
);
hint: DISTINCT, or an equivalent GROUP BY.
outputExplanation: The company has four distinct job titles: Manager, Engineer, Rep and Analyst.

tests.name: Department with no employees
Employees with NULL department and NULL salary
Single employee, single department
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO departments VALUES (1,'Engineering','Austin');
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'Solo','Engineer',100000,1,NULL,'2022-04-01');

tests.name: Duplicate names and same hire dates
Zero and negative salaries, boundary dates
NULL title present — NULL is a distinct value
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO departments VALUES (1,'IT','A');
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'A',NULL,100,1,NULL,'2020-01-01'),(2,'B','Engineer',100,1,1,'2020-01-01');

tests.name: All employees share the same title
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO departments VALUES (1,'IT','A');
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'A','Engineer',100,1,NULL,'2020-01-01'),(2,'B','Engineer',100,1,1,'2020-01-01'),(3,'C','Engineer',100,1,1,'2020-01-01');

tests.name: Case sensitivity — Engineer, engineer and ENGINEER are three distinct values
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO departments VALUES (1,'IT','A');
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'A','Engineer',100,1,NULL,'2020-01-01'),(2,'B','engineer',100,1,1,'2020-01-01'),(3,'C','ENGINEER',100,1,1,'2020-01-01');

tests.name: Leading and trailing whitespace makes titles distinct
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO departments VALUES (1,'IT','A');
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'A',' Engineer',100,1,NULL,'2020-01-01'),(2,'B','Engineer ',100,1,1,'2020-01-01'),(3,'C','Engineer',100,1,1,'2020-01-01');

tests.name: Mixed NULLs and duplicate titles
tests.seedSql:
INSERT INTO departments VALUES (1,'IT','A'),(2,'Sales','B');
INSERT INTO employees VALUES (1,'A',NULL,100,1,NULL,'2020-01-01'),(2,'B',NULL,100,1,1,'2020-01-01'),(3,'C','Engineer',100,2,NULL,'2020-01-01'),(4,'D','Rep',100,2,3,'2020-01-01');
